observation_source: Human photograph of the panic screen
panic: NATIVE_UFS smmu: SMR write idx=86 bank=73 step=SMR write off=958 exp=80000060 act=0 @NativeUfs.cpp:455
result: With userdata provisioned and a single default stream (sid 0x0060), the driver binds the UFS controller but cannot program its SMMU stream: the SMR write reads back zero.
limits: Establishes only that this SMMU register write has no effect for sid 0x0060; it does not prove the SMMU is locked, nor identify the firmware-configured stream id.
